Reactive store for a shared AlphaGraph

Source: R/class_graph_store.R
AlphaGraphStore.Rd

Holds one canonical AlphaGraph per Shiny session. All mutations are applied to a private copy and committed atomically by increasing a revision counter. Views depend on the revision; view rendering never writes back to the store, preventing graph/matrix feedback loops.

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Use $transact(source, mutate) for changes. Nested transactions are ignored and failed transactions preserve the previous graph. Reactive accessors must be used inside a reactive context, or inside shiny::isolate(). $snapshot() returns an independent graph without reactive dependencies.

AlphaGraphStore$transact()

Apply mutate to a private candidate and commit after optional validation. Failures preserve the previous state and are rethrown. Return invisible TRUE on commit or FALSE for a nested transaction.

Usage

AlphaGraphStore$transact(
  source,
  mutate,
  validate = TRUE,
  requireNumeric = FALSE
)

Arguments

source

Character scalar identifying the origin of a committed change.

mutate

Function that modifies a private candidate object before it is committed.

validate

Logical; whether to validate the imported, returned, or modified object.

requireNumeric

Logical; whether weights and transitions must be numerically computable.

AlphaGraphStore$clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

AlphaGraphStore$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

store <- createAlphaGraphStore()
store$snapshot()$toHypotheses()
#> H1_NI  H1_S H2_NI  H2_S 
#>     1     0     0     0 
shiny::isolate(store$revision())
#> [1] 0
